contract.A_log: FP32 [H]; prepare the no-copy flattening of [1,1,H,1] before capture
contract.cu_seqlens: host integer tuple or None; prepare from captured lengths before timing, never call device tolist inside capture
contract.semantics: bounded sigmoid gate -> inclusive token prefix sum reset per sequence/chunk -> 1/ln(2) scaling
contract.supported_raw_gate_scope: The inspected public adapter requires safe_gate=True, lower_bound in [-5,0), D<=256, and chunk size 32/64/128; variable-length rank4 requires B=1.

active_set: All 38 existing captured_shapes.json contracts, BF16 input, FP32 output, safe gate, chunk64, H=32,D=128; no substitution of the previous standalone softplus workload.
measurement_policy: Paired device Graph replay on the same NPU/container, identical logical inputs and sequence boundaries; compile/warmup and host metadata preparation outside capture. No new latency result recorded by this selection manifest.

runtime_preflight.status: selected reference identified, not runtime-ready in the probed environment
runtime_preflight.action_required_before_measurement: Provide/build the pinned vLLM-Ascend native extension in the personal container and verify binary/source provenance. Do not substitute another kernel when this operator is absent.

limitations: No binary provenance is inferred from an operator name alone. Check the installed extension/source revision before reporting measurements as this pinned reference.
The current portable GPU operator explicitly excludes Ascend. Selecting this reference does not constitute a completed Ascend implementation.
The previous standalone fused_kda_gate safe_gate=False baseline and the separate FLA-NPU npu_kda_gate_cumsum are not selected for this comparison.
